Description: Registers a new taxpayer account using Citizen ID, phone number, email, and password
Pre-Condition: Citizen ID and email must not already exist in the system

Description: Authenticates user credentials and issues a cryptographically signed JWT access token
Pre-Condition: User account exists and is in ACTIVE status

Description: Updates user password after verifying current password correctness
Pre-Condition: User is authenticated; current password matches database hash

Description: Retrieves authenticated user profile details (Name, DoB, Citizen ID, Tax Code, Phone)
Pre-Condition: User is authenticated in the system

Description: Updates user contact phone number, residential address, tax ID, and birth date
Pre-Condition: User is authenticated; input payload passes format validation

Description: Creates a new income stream (salary, business, capital) for the specified tax year
Pre-Condition: User is authenticated; gross income and withheld tax >= 0

Description: Modifies declared income figures and tax withheld at source
Pre-Condition: Income source exists and belongs to the authenticated user

Description: Automatically reconciles total declared income against withholding tax vouchers
Pre-Condition: Valid tax year; at least one declared income source exists

Description: Registers a new dependent (child, spouse, parent) for family circumstance relief
Pre-Condition: No overlapping deduction time window with other taxpayers

Description: Transitions dependent condition category (e.g., child under 18 to student over 18)
Pre-Condition: Dependent exists; profile resets to PENDING_DOCUMENTS

Description: Deactivates a dependent when eligibility ceases while retaining audit history
Pre-Condition: Dependent record belongs to the authenticated user

Description: Uploads birth/identity/disability certificates and performs automated AI OCR verification
Pre-Condition: Dependent exists; file format is valid (PDF/Image) and <= 10MB

Description: Retrieves paginated and filtered document compliance rules by relationship category
Pre-Condition: User is authorized to query regulatory document rules

Description: Initializes or retrieves the PIT finalization declaration period for a given tax year
Pre-Condition: User is authenticated; tax year complies with legal window

Description: Uploads multiple tax slips/invoices and triggers background AI OCR processing
Pre-Condition: Tax period is in DRAFT status and not locked

Description: Confirms and finalizes parsed voucher line-items following user verification
Pre-Condition: Document OCR extraction completed; user verifies numbers

Description: Finalizes and submits the tax declaration, locking attached documents from alteration
Pre-Condition: Tax period contains valid income and dependent deduction data

Description: Aggregates income, reliefs, and computes provisional payable or refundable tax amount
Pre-Condition: Tax dossier contains complete income and deduction records

Description: Locks final tax computation data and saves the official finalization dossier
Pre-Condition: Settlement has been previewed and confirmed by the user

Description: Submits tax policy inquiries to the AI assistant model and receives contextual guidance
Pre-Condition: Chat session is active; user is authenticated

Description: Submits candidate profile with portrait photo and tax practice certificates for review
Pre-Condition: Application is in DRAFT status with avatar and valid certificates

Description: Admin approves qualified candidate, upgrades role to Expert, and generates ExpertProfile
Pre-Condition: Application is in PENDING_REVIEW; actor has Admin role

Description: Admin rejects unqualified application with formal justification feedback
Pre-Condition: Application is in review; rejection reason is mandatory

Description: Searches and filters verified experts by keyword, specialty, fee rate, rating, and slots
Pre-Condition: Expert profile is approved and active in public directory

Description: Retrieves public expert profile details with masked PII and aggregated rating metrics
Pre-Condition: Expert exists and profile is publicly active

Description: Configures recurring or individual consultation time slots on the expert calendar
Pre-Condition: User has Expert role; time slots do not overlap

Description: Schedules a consultation appointment and holds slot for 10 minutes pending payment
Pre-Condition: Expert slot is AVAILABLE and satisfies lead-time policy

Description: Expert accepts booking request within the mandatory 2-hour confirmation window
Pre-Condition: Booking is in PENDING_ACCEPTANCE status

Description: Expert declines booking with reason, triggering automatic escrow refund
Pre-Condition: Booking is awaiting acceptance; actor is assigned expert

Description: Client cancels appointment in accordance with platform refund/cancellation rules
Pre-Condition: Session has not started; requester is the booking owner

Description: Authorizes session participant and issues secure video meeting room credentials
Pre-Condition: Requester is the client or expert of the booking, in active window

Description: Expert concludes session, submitting mandatory summary notes and conclusions
Pre-Condition: Session is IN_PROGRESS; summary conclusion notes are provided

Description: Reports counterpart absence after 15-minute grace period for penalty/refund action
Pre-Condition: 15 minutes elapsed since start time; counterpart has not joined

Description: Generates VNPay gateway payment URL and VietQR code for booking deposit
Pre-Condition: Booking is in PENDING_PAYMENT status and slot hold is active

Description: Validates HMAC-SHA512 gateway signature and registers funds in escrow
Pre-Condition: Webhook payload received with authentic cryptographic signature

Description: Client confirms satisfaction within 24-hour cool-down, releasing payout early
Pre-Condition: Booking is COMPLETED and within 24-hour cool-down window

Description: Client files service quality dispute, immediately freezing escrowed funds
Pre-Condition: Within 24-hour cool-down window; no prior active dispute

Description: Admin adjudicates dispute and executes financial settlement (refund or payout)
Pre-Condition: Dispute is OPEN; executed by authorized Admin user

Description: Expert requests payout from earned balance to verified bank account
Pre-Condition: Expert is eKYC verified, has valid Tax ID, balance >= threshold

Description: Admin approves or declines payout request with banking reference code
Pre-Condition: Withdrawal request is PENDING; executed by Admin user

Description: Client submits numerical rating (1-5 stars) and feedback following session
Pre-Condition: Booking is COMPLETED; review deadline is active; not yet reviewed

Description: Expert posts a public reply to client feedback (one-time only)
Pre-Condition: Public review exists; actor is the reviewed expert

Description: Updates read status for a targeted system notification
Pre-Condition: Notification exists and belongs to the authenticated user
